# cubepath_vps_isos (Data Source)

Lists the ISO images that can be mounted on a VPS (iso_id of cubepath_vps).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vps_id` (Number) ID of the VPS.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The VPS ID.
- `isos` (Attributes List) Available ISOs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--isos))

<a id="nestedatt--isos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `isos`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `file_size` (Number) Size in bytes.
- `filename` (String) File name.
- `id` (String) ISO ID.
- `is_mounted` (Boolean) Whether it is mounted on the VPS.
- `name` (String) Name.
